_note: Fixed before the first model run (brief section 9). These are our own suggestions, not standards. Do not edit after seeing results.
splits: shop-level; test = later vintages plus held-out noise level 0.14 and the held-out archetype mix seasonal+declining; calibration and conformal splits are separate
document_understanding: printed bills field F1 >= 0.85; handwritten reported, not targeted
classifier: beats the logistic baseline and the rules on Brier score, CI reported
conformal: empirical coverage within 3 points of the 90% target
watchman: median lead time >= 2 months; fewer false alarms per borrower-year on seasonal shops than the fixed 30% threshold
counterfactuals: >= 90% valid; no change to a protected or unchangeable feature
tamper: report the full curve, no single headline number
allocator: cap compliance 100%; lower concentration than a naive split
